# line_rich_menu (Resource)

Manages a rich menu (POST/GET/DELETE /v2/bot/richmenu) and its attached image (POST /v2/bot/richmenu/{id}/content, on the separate api-data.line.me host). The Messaging API has no update endpoint for a rich menu's body, so changing name, chat_bar_text, selected, size, or areas forces replacement; only image_path can change in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "line_rich_menu" "this" {
  name          = "nice rich menu"
  chat_bar_text = "Menu"
  selected      = false
  image_path    = "${path.module}/rich-menu.png"

  size = {
    width  = 2500
    height = 1686
  }

  areas = [
    {
      bounds = {
        x      = 0
        y      = 0
        width  = 2500
        height = 1686
      }
      action = {
        type  = "postback"
        data  = "action=buy&itemid=123"
        label = null
        text  = null
        uri   = null
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `areas` (Attributes List) Tappable areas. At most 20. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--areas))
- `chat_bar_text` (String) Text displayed in the chat bar. At most 14 characters.
- `name` (String) Internal name for managing the rich menu; not shown to users. At most 300 characters.
- `size` (Attributes) Pixel size of the rich menu image. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--size))

### Optional

- `image_path` (String) Local filesystem path to a .png or .jpg/.jpeg image to attach. Changing this re-uploads the image in place without recreating the rich menu. The API has no way to detach an image once attached, so clearing this attribute is a no-op rather than a delete.
- `selected` (Boolean) Whether this is the menu shown by default. Does not by itself set it as every user's default menu — see line_rich_menu_default for that.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `image_hash` (String) SHA-256 hash of the last successfully uploaded image, used to detect drift in image_path's content since GetRichMenu never returns the image itself.

<a id="nestedatt--areas"></a>
### Nested Schema for `areas`

Required:

- `action` (Attributes) Action triggered on tap. type must be one of postback, message, uri. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--areas--action))
- `bounds` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--areas--bounds))

<a id="nestedatt--areas--action"></a>
### Nested Schema for `areas.action`

Required:

Optional:

- `data` (String) Required when type = postback.
- `label` (String)
- `text` (String) Required when type = message.
- `uri` (String) Required when type = uri.
